name: tatsuju-opdstar-nhi-mcp
description: Taiwan's first public MCP server for National Health Insurance (NHI) data — 234 rejection codes, 1,497 ICD-10→procedure mappings across 20 specialties, audit indicators (008/014/027/P043), and semantic wiki search over 8,232 chunks of official NHI documentation. Powered by [OPDSTAR](https://opdstar.com). Install: `npx @opdstar/nhi-mcp`.
